description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the ratio and minFDE20 for various methods, including TrajICL, Head Tuning, FT, LoRA 16, and LoRA 64. The x-axis represents the ratio, with a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis represents minFDE20, also with a linear scale, spanning from 0.8 to 1.3, and tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The plot displays five lines, each corresponding to a different method: TrajICL (blue, solid line with circle markers), Head Tuning (orange, solid line with circle markers), FT (green, solid line with circle markers), LoRA 16 (red, solid line with circle markers), and LoRA 64 (purple, solid line with circle markers). The TrajICL line starts at approximately 0.89 at a ratio of 0.1 and decreases to around 0.84 at a ratio of 1.0. The Head Tuning line begins at about 1.31 at a ratio of 0.1 and declines to roughly 1.05 at a ratio of 1.0. The FT line commences at approximately 1.1 at a ratio of 0.1, decreases to around 0.86 at a ratio of 0.8, and then drops to about 0.78 at a ratio of 1.0. The LoRA 16 line starts at around 1.2 at a ratio of 0.1 and decreases to approximately 0.93 at a ratio of 1.0. The LoRA 64 line begins at about 1.2 at a ratio of 0.1 and declines to roughly 0.93 at a ratio of 1.0.
